notes.title: Technical Demo Update - v0.3.7.19
notes.content:
[p][b]What's new! Development -[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Included a Settlement Generator for the preview mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased RTS Units sample size for preview testing![/p][/*][*][p]Removed previously a sample city from the technical demo map.[/p][/*][*][p]Included a small sample starter river for an initial preview.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a bit more clarity with some new UI dialog box after loading.[/p][/*][*][p]Included new keybinds controls for RTS Unit handling & Interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved color grading of the initial technical demo map. [/p][/*][*][p]Territory sample included - just some fancy border and fill.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979695/144b59e964a81ab8eb1c52e74251fd6a85fdd446.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979695/20e186db3e06c3f2e20e1ba7fb9512cfe584e4bc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979695/128e1ceb1085d85c0145a33e15066f6a03ca950d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979695/fe9218ba3da57155fd53b26bc067463f1d6c1f76.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979695/e28535650a922b95db2ad00af035c2a9d07f7d24.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979695/4a6fe45a729c5eb181366672990bb0bc8f1641d4.png"][/img][/carousel][p][b]Development Notes:
[/b]
Be aware that the starting default mode is not applied to anything, you must press "N" to navigate to any debug mechanic in order to be able to select hexes in the world. It is only then can you click anywhere on the map to generate a settlement sample by pressing on "G".

You can also press "J" to randomly selected a hex in the world and to be teleported to that location. [/p][p]For control of RTS Units- you can click on 1 or 2 for formation type placement. "R" for making the unit run faster. "K" to display the formation preview location of the unit. [/p][p][/p][p]Be advised that if you are to press "H" to display the border effect territory, you will need to press "J" - I had accidentally keybinded two actions into one! You can always restart your game, saved-games aren't actually saving any game data or loading game data at the moment. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]What's next?[/b]

The goal is simple, to continue progressing this technical demo into a 'viable' game product that can have a bit of a solid tangible game-play experience by the end of 2025. This demo will be up for the public to enjoy for the time being, I've lost all interest in resuming any internal play-testing or forcing any sort of sign-ups. 

Game mechanics is up in the air, scope is anywhere and everywhere- so a lot of upcoming changes/updates will revolve around expanding the Overview Unit Mode, Tactical (RTS) Unit mode, Settlement Builder/Management Mode, and UI/UX expansion/improvements. 

[/p]

notes.title: Technical Demo Preview has Launched for 4X Fest!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979695/c17eb9a6262c6ae213210fe02c758ea0dc69a8ee.png"][/img][/p][h1][u]4X Fest Event - Technical Demo[/u][/h1][p]
Hello folks, I have gone ahead and prematurely released the current play-test build for the demo app. You will notice that it is not a feature complete or a 'proper' demo. If anything, it is more of a technical demo that will help push out some of the core elements and objectives that I had over the summer. 

Here's a quick glance of things that will be updated ([i]hopefully[/i]) for this 4X Week Event: [/p][list][*][p]Introducing RTS Sample Demo Maps- "Siege Battle" & "Skirmish Battle" [/p][/*][*][p]Refining & Expanding the "Overview Demo Map" (The current playable map)[/p][/*][*][p]Expand on Debug Mechanic Tools for player manipulation of the world in Real-time. [/p][/*][*][p]Expand UI/UX for Battle Mode, Menu/Panel Tabs, and/or Overview mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Introducing City-Building Map Level alongside Settlement Manager Menu(s). [/p][/*][/list][p]No considerable dates as of yet but this small-time release will help put out some visibility for my little ambitious project.

The current status after a year of development is soon forming out of the Pre-Alpha Development stages. Numerous iterations and researching on my end to this ball rolling has been great. Much of the focus now will be not only optimization but as well as player data and gameplay mechanics. More robust play-tests will begin later in September after consolidating the next batch of players.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979695/016deedbbd0013b78aa90a46c9358c6aa5f15966.png"][/img][/p][p]Join the Discord Server if you want to get in touch with me more easily.[/p][p][b]Discord Community:[/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/EgkXahAWD6"]https://discord.gg/EgkXahAWD6[/url][/p][p][/p][p][i]Enjoy the preview build of this demo!~[/i] [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Pre-Alpha Development - Style Update & City Building Expansion
notes.content:
Here's an update on the current design of Fort Settlements and Buildable Pieces. This features a Mesopotamian-esque style city. This current map area and primitive features will be seen in the tutorial mode. 

Includes moat/irrigation trenches alongside new path texture styles and buildings. As well as some basic special monuments and religious buildings. Included are boat assets that have yet to be configured within the building system of a shipyard. 

[list]
[*] x7 Generic Housing Structures
[*] x1 Pantheon Shrine
[*] x7 Defense Structures
[*] x3 Farming Types
[*] x3 Path/Ground Types
[/list]

Note: This development update for the pre-alpha build is still currently at a conceptual stage. Assets, Artworks, design, themes, and backend systems are still being tinkered. 

[previewyoutube=CjKJ0ontuQo;full][/previewyoutube]

Includes also primitive units and rendered animated states for the tactical battle modes. An early-scope into the battle system. Can go upwards to 100k rendered units within a scene. Further optimizations are needed to enable a proper pathfinding for these units and of course to be taken into account how RTS elements will be incorporated within the overview battle modes. 

[list]
[*] x5 Persian Units (Archer x1, Spearmen x2, & Swordsmen x2)
[*] x2 Greek Units (Spearmen & Swordsmen)
[*] x2 Generic Civilian Units (Pleb Man & Pleb Woman)
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CY4Sb7l.jpeg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yG3fXv3.jpeg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KmAU97j.jpeg[/img]

In terms of development, the goal moving forward is to finalize a style and theme for this game project. In addition to pivoting more into tangible gameplay footage of the primitive systems. This will coincide with steam page overhaul and updates of capsules for this steam app. 

Due to financial strains, this is to be expected to take longer than usual in terms of acquiring a decent kit bash of assets and/or artwork modifications to appear in a sense- a viable conceptual game. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HNW9bsX.jpeg[/img]

Despite the patchy hot mess of style and assets- more developmental news will be made soon over the coming weeks. Mostly in terms of city-management and city-building alongside nation/grand management of a nation. I.e: Managing more than 3 cities + towns. 

Note: Towns will not be something that a player can customize and/or edit, only provincially designated cities can be customized. In addition to ensuring that auto-generated districts and/or ease of customizable cities is implemented for the player to utilize. This is to prevent micromanagement pains that might occur and is something to be tested more-so in the coming future with the expansion of city & town generations.
